blocks.text: The Committee shall convene initially on or before July 1, 2015, and at least once every 10 years thereafter, as directed by the City Council by way of an appropriate resolution. (Ord. 20206 § 76, 9-10-19; Ord. 19320 § 6, 10-13-09. Code 1995 § 2-13. Formerly 2.13.040.)
